description: 繁體中文：Nivqo v1.33.0 同版覆蓋更新，內建 HushFacebook 0.6.0-nivqo.1 正式核心（只同步上游正式 v0.6.0），HushFacebook patch metadata 更新為 59 / 59 繁體中文，並保留 HushMessenger 0.7.0-nivqo.1 與 31 / 31 繁中 metadata。App 顯示版本仍為 1.33.0；v1.32.0 與舊 v1.33.0 可直接覆蓋更新。 English: Same-version Nivqo v1.33.0 replacement with the formal HushFacebook 0.6.0-nivqo.1 core (formal upstream v0.6.0 only), 59 / 59 HushFacebook patch metadata localized in Traditional Chinese, and the existing HushMessenger 0.7.0-nivqo.1 core with 31 / 31 localized metadata. The installed version name remains 1.33.0 and existing v1.32.0 / older v1.33.0 builds can update in place.
